scope: User-authorized full-song local pseudo-label generation only; no student training, blind scoring, deployment, SD writes or uploads

authorization.pilot_feedback: User: 效果很好 (provided listening comparison; not a per-song review of the entire library)
authorization.batch_request: Assistant offered full training-song separation while keeping the deployed model; user: 开始

precision: Same CUDA float16 autocast recipe as pilot; STFT/iSTFT float32; no silent precision/chunk fallback
input: Complete first audio stream, ffmpeg to stereo 44100 Hz little-endian float32, no normalization; decode failures quarantined, not truncated
labels: Unnormalized FLOAT32 stereo vocals and accompaniment = exact decoded mix minus vocals; no separate gain, clipping, mask compression or cropped training windows
isolation: Exclude all known regression/holdout, existing DEVELOPMENT and blind IDs, new Cambridge non-train candidates, historical MP3 holdout reports, and legacy chills exclusion before any audio decode; also exclude matching byte aliases
duplicate_policy: Conservative filename/version composition grouping and full decoded PCM SHA-256 for eligible files; identical PCM counted once; differing recordings/edits of one named composition quarantined, not silently multiplied
split_caveat: Exact PCM identity and conservative title aliases do not prove exhaustive acoustic near-duplicate detection, artist isolation, teacher pretraining independence or new blind data
source_rights: Local research only; possession of MP3s is not certification of commercial training or redistribution rights
